messages:
jordan: quick ping — can someone take a look at https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821? it's a small client change: header parsing + streaming fallback. hoping for merge today if CI is green. tl;dr: normalize `x-rw-region` header and fall back to chunked streaming for older nodes. thanks!
mira: curious — does this change any public SDK surface? will it require a minor version bump?
jordan: no API shape changes, only runtime header normalization and a shim in rest-client to convert `content-length`=0 -> chunked streaming. tests added. patch summary in PR description.
sam: i'll take a look after stand. quick skim — please add an integration test covering toolcall streaming fallback, we had a regression there last month.
jordan: noted, adding test now. snippet in PR: `if (!resp.headers['transfer-encoding'] && resp.headers['content-length'] === '0') resp.headers['transfer-encoding']='chunked'`
cate: @sam @mira i'll run the feature matrix locally and try to repro with older runtime images, ping me if you want me to block merge.
ci-bot: build started for PR #4821 — pipeline: unit → integration → e2e. status: queued.
mira: also left a small comment about header casing in the client wrapper.
sam: lgtm from me once tests are added. :+1:
jordan: pushed tests and addressed mira's comment. CI kicked off.
ci-bot: unit tests passed. integration pending.
cate: can we merge if integration is flaky? we should hold until e2e passes for this one.
jordan: totally — I'll wait for e2e. ETA ~30m.
ci-bot: integration failed on a flakey env var. rerunning.
ci-bot: e2e passed. all checks green.
mira: approved. please squash and merge during today's merge window (2:00–3:00pm PT).
jordan: thanks all, will merge at 2pm. :pray:
